items.title: 9.1.3 How Does Design Thinking Apply to Business Solutions? (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of design thinking in business (PDF 209).

blocks.text: Design thinking companies ko aise products aur services banane mein madad deti hai jo log asal mein chahte hain. Company online khana order karna aasan banane wali app ke liye ise istemal kar sakti hai, user ke tajurbe par tawajjo de kar aur mukhtalif khayalat aazma kar jab tak app istemal mein aasan aur kamyab na ho.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: un students par design thinking lagayein jo after-school activities ki wajah se homework ka waqt nahi pate. Har qadam kya de sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Empathize: interviews batate hain ke students jaldi aur thakan mehsoos karte hain. Define: 'students ko activities ke saath homework fit karne ka tareeqa chahiye'. Ideate: mushtarak planner, college mein homework ka ghanta, hafte ke dinon mein kam activities. Prototype: haftawar timetable ka sancha. Test: students ek hafta aazma kar tabdeeliyan batate hain, jo agle version mein shamil hoti hain.

blocks.prompt: Business solutions banane mein design thinking ki ahmiyat misalon ke saath bataiye (long question 1).
blocks.explanation: Design thinking aisi cheez banane ka khatra kam karti hai jo koi na chahe, kyunke yeh users ki asal zarooraton se shuru hoti aur bara kharcha karne se pehle sasti prototypes se khayalat aazmati hai. Yeh bohat se khayalat ki hosla afzai karti hai, to hal zyada takhleeqi hote hain, aur baar baar ki aazmaish products ko qadam ba qadam behtar karti hai. Misalein: user tests se behtar hui food-ordering app; students ki shikayaton se bana school bag; grocery store jo gahakon se pareshaniyan pooch kar delivery service dobara banata hai.

items: Design thinking business solutions ko user markooz aur aazmooda banati hai (food-ordering app).
